WITH review_images AS ( SELECT ri.review_id, LISTAGG(ri.file_name, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ri.file_name) AS file_names FROM review_img ri GROUP BY ri.review_id ), review_comments AS ( SELECT review_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM comments GROUP BY review_id ) SELECT r.review_id AS review_id, r.review_title AS review_title, m.member_nickname AS member_nickname, r.review_star AS review_star, r.review_content AS review_content, r.review_regdate AS review_regdate, r.review_cnt AS review_cnt, r.review_like AS review_like, r.review_hate AS review_hate, m.member_email AS member_email, ri.file_names AS file_names, COALESCE(rc.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count FROM review r LEFT JOIN review_images ri ON r.review_id = ri.review_id LEFT JOIN member m ON r.member_email = m.member_email LEFT JOIN review_comments rc ON r.review_id = rc.review_id WHERE r.review_id = #{review_id}

SELECT tp.plan_day, tp.plan_seq, a.attr_name FROM travel_plan tp LEFT OUTER JOIN attr a ON tp.attr_id = a.attr_id WHERE tp.info_id = (SELECT info_id FROM review WHERE review_id = #{review_id}) ORDER BY tp.plan_day, tp.plan_seq

mapper.select: WITH review_images AS ( SELECT ri.review_id, LISTAGG(ri.file_name, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ri.file_name) AS file_names FROM review_img ri GROUP BY ri.review_id ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT r.review_id, r.review_title, r.review_regdate, r.review_cnt, m.member_nickname, COALESCE(ri.file_names, '') AS file_names, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.review_cnt DESC) AS rn FROM review r INNER JOIN member m ON r.member_email = m.member_email LEFT JOIN review_images ri ON r.review_id = ri.review_id ) WHERE rn <= 3

WITH review_images AS ( SELECT ri.review_id, LISTAGG(ri.file_name, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ri.file_name) AS file_names FROM review_img ri GROUP BY ri.review_id ), review_likes AS ( SELECT r.review_id, COUNT(l.like_id) AS like_count FROM review r LEFT JOIN likes l ON r.review_id = l.review_id GROUP BY r.review_id ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT r.review_id, r.review_title, r.review_regdate, m.member_nickname, COALESCE(ri.file_names, '') AS file_names, COALESCE(rl.like_count, 0) AS like_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(rl.like_count, 0) DESC) AS rn FROM review r INNER JOIN member m ON r.member_email = m.member_email LEFT JOIN review_images ri ON r.review_id = ri.review_id LEFT JOIN review_likes rl ON r.review_id = rl.review_id ) WHERE rn <= 3
